resolution.note: lane verdict prints turns N from num_turns; test reads verbatim capture

title: lane run verdict reports the session's turn count
body:
Why: the Python pilot table (t-811vn27) needs turns per lane; lane run reports cost but drops num_turns from the session result.
Outcome: the lane verdict line prints `turns N` next to the cost when the session result carries num_turns.
Proof: test/cli/lane-run.test.ts parses the verbatim capture test/fixtures/claude/headless-session-result.json (num_turns 1).
